test_harness_lessons: Use verified Unreal Python ScriptName aliases: WidgetLibrary and Controller.get_controlled_pawn
UnrealEditor-Cmd exits after script execution unless EditorPythonScripting.set_keep_python_script_alive(True) is set for asynchronous checks
Never change editor maps from a Slate callback: load_map can pump callbacks recursively and reenter World Partition initialization. Use one map per process.
Earlier incomplete or crashed harness runs are not evidence of a gameplay regression
Native automation test worlds must InitializeActorsForPlay so default GAS attribute sets are discovered through component initialization.

Unreal Python uses FEditorScriptExecutionGuard: AActor::GetFunctionCallspace returns Local whenever GAllowActorScriptExecutionInEditor is true. Remote action tests must dispatch through a scoped native PIE test bridge with this editor-only override disabled.
Guard Slate callbacks against reentry during asset loads. Prefer an existing map package for stable PIE level identity.

Do not rely on modifying native CDO primitive defaults in Python to populate native runtime fixture instances. Explicitly configure server-owned transient fixtures. Convert FName map keys to strings before Python string-key comparisons.
unreal.get_objects_with_outer does not exist in UE 5.8 Python; enumerate widget trees through DTStructRepairLibrary.inspect_skill_widgets or root_widget children
NiagaraEmitter assets cannot populate UNiagaraSystem properties; verify asset class before assignment and keep a same-school system fallback
verification_limitations: Unattended null-RHI checks do not establish visual correctness or physical keyboard/mouse behavior
Loading MainMenu and Tutorial independently does not validate clicking a menu button to travel
Blueprint compiler totals do not measure gameplay completion
restoration_direction: Follow the original RPG gameplay references for the main player, as clarified by the user. Player progression is hybrid: skills can be combined across trees as the character levels up; class references do not impose exclusive class locks. Follow Docs/PlayerProgressionContract.json. Keep AI-only classes separate. Understand models, skeletons, animations, GAS stats/abilities, equipment, learned skill ranks, hotbar/passive assignments and skill-tree rules as a connected system before gameplay rewiring. Tutorial currently selecting the DT motion-matching pawn is a wiring observation, not proof that the DT hierarchy is the intended restored gameplay base.
